title: Update your NDIS Worker Check details
summary: Learn how to update your NDIS Worker Check details online through your MyServiceNSW Account.
intro:
If you have an NDIS Worker Check clearance you must update any changes to your details within 3 months of the change. This is a requirement under Section 18 of the National Disability Insurance Scheme (Worker Checks) Act 2018.

You can update some of your details online through your MyServiceNSW Account.

### How it works

Your NDIS Worker Check is:
who_can_apply: Must have an NDIS Worker Check clearance.
Must have made changes to personal details (address or contact details).
what_you_need: Your new details (address or contact details)
Personal email and mobile phone number

how_to_steps.text: Select the 'Go to NDIS Worker Check' button.
Log in to your MyServiceNSW Account.
Select 'NDIS Worker Check' from the dashboard.
Follow the prompts to update your details.
Log in to your MyServiceNSW Account.
Select Yes to 'Do you currently hold a NSW NDISWC or have you previously applied in NSW?'

faqs.q: How often do I need to update my NDIS Worker Check details?
faqs.a: If you have an NDIS Worker Check clearance, you must update any changes to your details within 3 months of the change, as required by the National Disability Insurance Scheme (Worker Checks) Act 2018.

faqs.q: What information do I need to update?
faqs.a: You can update your name, residential address, and contact details (email and phone number).

faqs.q: How do I update my NDIS Worker Check details online?
faqs.a: You can update your details online by logging into your MyServiceNSW Account, selecting 'NDIS Worker Check' from the dashboard, and following the prompts.
